notes: observe_only is safe for initial integration: it only requires YOLO success and point1/point2.
Do not set confirmed_for_motion=true on a threshold profile until the process owner has approved the numeric limits.
These profiles do not execute motion. Business scripts must stop when detect_shelf reports ok=false.

observe_only.description: Only require a successful shelf detection with point1 and point2. No numeric process thresholds.
